record.title: Rationalized All-Atom Protein Design with Unified Multi-Modal Bayesian Flow
record.decision_reason: ProBayes jointly designs protein sequence/backbone/sidechains using Bayesian flows while preventing sidechain-to-sequence shortcuts. Actualp9–10 peptide co-design/binding conformations use PepBench/PepBDB, and CDR-H3 antibody design uses SAbDab training/RAbD test. Biological design is the main task, with computational structure,energy,sequence recovery metrics; no wet-lab or clinical efficacy inferred. Table2 DockQ upward arrow contradicts prose calling it lowest; do not repeat that wording.

record.title: D-VST: Diffusion Transformer for Pathology-Correct Tone-Controllable Cross-Dye Virtual Staining of Whole Slide Images
record.decision_reason: D-VST is pathology-preserving cross-dye virtual staining. Physicalp7 datasets RegH2I2592pairs,FFPE2HE5098pairs,HEMIT5292pairs cover breast/colon histopathology; p8–9 HER2-label downstream classification and pathology/tone decoupling are substantive medical outcomes, with p10 limitations. Large0.2–1.3billion-pixel WSI examples are qualitative only. Image/label metrics are not clinical deployment or patient benefit validation.
